clauses.text: We cover accidental loss or damage to your vehicle caused by collision, impact or overturning.
We cover loss of your vehicle by theft or attempted theft, provided reasonable security precautions were taken.
We do not cover loss or damage while the vehicle is driven by an unlicensed driver or a driver under the influence.
We cover loss or damage to your home and contents caused by fire, explosion or smoke.
We cover loss or damage caused by storm, rainwater or flash flooding entering the building.
We cover loss of contents by burglary where there is visible evidence of forced entry.
We do not cover damage caused by a lack of maintenance, wear and tear, or gradual deterioration.
We cover accidental loss or damage to the building caused by fire or storm.
This policy covers the building only. Contents, including stolen items, are not covered.
We cover your legal liability for damage your vehicle causes to other people's property. Damage to your own vehicle is not covered.
